q: The Birkhoff normal form near an elliptic fixed point of a symplectic map T reduces T (to any order) to a map of the form (Iₖ = |zₖ|²):
opts: zₖ ↦ e^{i(ωₖ + Σⱼ aₖⱼIⱼ)}zₖ (twist map in each action)
exp: Birkhoff normal form: the symplectic map near a non-resonant elliptic fixed point is formally conjugate to zₖ ↦ exp(i(ωₖ + Σⱼ aₖⱼ|zⱼ|²))zₖ — a nonlinear twist. The coefficients aₖⱼ are the Birkhoff constants, which determine the KAM condition and Arnold diffusion.
